implementation_summary: deploy.yml cloud-run deploy step maps AUDIT_STORE_BUCKET, FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID, FIREBASE_WEB_API_KEY, FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN from GitHub repository variables into step env and appends them to --set-env-vars; existing env vars, the access-token secret and the main-only trigger are unchanged; the site job is untouched. DEPLOYMENT.md gains 'Website Audit storage and Helper sign-in': local runs use <RUNNER_DATA_DIR>/audit-store/ with no cloud account; hosted copy keeps audits and Shared Links in the bucket; gcloud bucket create in us-central1 (Standard, uniform access, public access prevention, soft delete 0); versioning off, no lifecycle rule, verify/clear commands (Q-30); roles/storage.objectAdmin on the bucket only for the runtime service account; Firebase CLI and console setup for Google sign-in in the same project (Q-44); the repository variables; VITE_FIREBASE_* as an optional build-time fallback. New test asserts the wiring and the documented settings.

tests_executed.name: deploy wiring and guide test plus release workflow test

tests_proposed: Post-setup check that gcloud storage buckets describe matches the documented settings

risks: Existing --set-env-vars value RUNNER_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=$RUNNER_URL,https://qa-check-up-cnhl7suwnq-uc.a.run.app contains a comma, which gcloud uses as the variable separator; the second origin may be misparsed. Left unchanged per the acceptance criteria; consider the ^@^ delimiter syntax.

gcloud storage and Firebase CLI flags (--soft-delete-duration=0, --clear-soft-delete, --clear-lifecycle, --no-versioning, describe format fields, firebase projects:addfirebase/apps:create/apps:sdkconfig) were written from knowledge and not checked against current docs.
Enabling the Google provider and adding authorized domains are documented as Firebase console steps, not CLI commands.
Always-free tier figures were not checked against current Google pricing.
Until the four repository variables are set, the hosted copy stores audits in /tmp (lost on redeploy) and Helper sign-in stays off.
handoff: Before setting the four repository variables, the developer runs the one-time setup in docs/DEPLOYMENT.md steps 1-4. Reviewers should check the deploy.yml step (CI, P2) and the existing RUNNER_ALLOWED_ORIGINS comma issue. Nothing was pushed or deployed.
